'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Kevin Shannon LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Username:''' Kevbozzz
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
